shutdown.directive: Stop all RL-OPSD work that launches or waits on MLQ jobs; do not submit or retry runs; remain analysis-only until the redesigned method and validation plan are reviewed.

v1_natural_beta_teacher.failure: independent finite per-sample Beta projections and KL capping distorted signed advantage magnitude and did not produce useful policy improvement

v2_scalar_log_density_teacher.failure: standardized-GAE scalar log-density target was underdetermined for two finite Beta parameters and remained substantially unfitted

v3_lr_matched_scalar_teacher.result: curve remained incomplete because jobs were externally cancelled
v3_lr_matched_scalar_teacher.failure: higher nominal learning rate did not resolve target residual or critic undertraining and epoch-times-learning-rate matching was not valid

rejected_mirror_pg.classification: KL-regularized mirror/proximal policy-gradient RL, not OPSD
reasons: The detached old policy has no privileged context and contains no improvement information.
All improvement signal remains the sampled policy-gradient term.
At pi_new == pi_old the KL gradient is zero.
The natural-gradient interpretation applies only to an exact small-step linearized proximal solve, not repeated stale-data Adam passes.
The negative-advantage empirical objective can be unbounded even with forward KL.
Forward KL to the old policy can oppose the concentration dynamics observed in the strong base.
It does not resolve the finite-Beta privileged-teacher requirement.

tokenized_implementation.grid: midpoints x_j in (0,1) with quadrature weights w_j
tokenized_implementation.old_log_mass: log_p_old_dj = log Beta(x_j; alpha_old_d, beta_old_d) + log(w_j)
tokenized_implementation.student_log_mass: student_logits_dj = log Beta(x_j; alpha_student_d, beta_student_d) + log(w_j)

privileged_context.positive_advantage_effect: increases teacher mass in the sampled action's policy-scaled neighborhood
privileged_context.negative_advantage_effect: suppresses that neighborhood and redistributes mass according to the recorded old policy
privileged_context.paper_distinction: the privilege enters through a fixed kernel-energy adapter rather than a learned language prompt or a separately conditioned copy of the network

pkt_objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: A bounded, full advantage-conditioned kernel-tilt teacher gives an identifiable dense per-coordinate target. With actor-critic optimization held at base parity, teacher-to-student KL should decline across passes, positive and negative student-minus-old neighborhood mass should move in opposite directions, and the completed 8M curve will determine usefulness without assuming it beats the base.

fixed_hyperparameters.gradient_clipping: separate actor and critic clipping exactly matching the requested base
fixed_hyperparameters.cuda_graph_requirement: complete fixed-shape forward, dual backward, clipping, Adam update, and parameter writes

quadrature_tokens.selection_rule: smallest candidate satisfying every independent-oracle fidelity threshold

teacher_strength.selection_rule: largest candidate satisfying every numerical displacement and effective-support bound; no return data may be used

pre_run_gates.name: continuous_teacher_and_tokenization_fidelity
pre_run_gates.oracle: independent adaptive float64 integration of the continuous teacher with absolute tolerance 1e-12 and relative tolerance 1e-10; midpoint-grid agreement is not an oracle
pre_run_gates.pass_action: freeze the smallest passing token count
pre_run_gates.fail_action: reject PKT tokenization; do not implement or run

pre_run_gates.name: teacher_strength_and_finite_precision_safety
pre_run_gates.inputs: deterministic coverage tensors only; no return-based selection
pre_run_gates.pass_action: freeze the largest passing teacher strength
pre_run_gates.fail_action: revise the privilege energy or bandwidth; do not implement or run

pre_run_gates.name: finite_unimodal_beta_projection_expressivity
pre_run_gates.boundary_condition: an optimum seeking alpha or beta toward the architecture boundary at 1 is a failure, not a valid projection
pre_run_gates.fail_action: replace the teacher family, kernel, or divergence orientation; do not implement or run

pre_run_gates.name: fixed_batch_learning_alignment_and_gradient_interference
pre_run_gates.scope: deterministic shared-network batches; aggregate behavior, not impossible per-sample guarantees
required_measurements: actor shared-trunk gradient norm before and after clipping
critic shared-trunk gradient norm before and after clipping
pre_run_gates.fail_action: revise PKT teacher construction; do not implement or run

pre_run_gates.name: gradient_detachment_optimizer_and_cuda_graph_equivalence
checks: no gradients to teacher masses, old concentrations, sampled actions, or advantages
teacher-to-student forward-KL orientation on asymmetric Beta cases
automatic-gradient agreement with float64 finite differences
complete eager versus CUDA-captured ten-pass update equivalence
Adam parameters, moments, and step counters advance correctly
full optimizer step and parameter writes are captured
static input and gradient buffer lifetimes remain valid
pre_run_gates.fail_action: fix implementation and repeat deterministic validation; no MLQ run

pre_run_gates.name: requested_base_parity_and_instrumentation_audit
must_match: critic MTP targets, loss, and update count
required_per_pass_metrics: KL(q_teacher || p_student): mean, median, p95, p99, max
KL(q_teacher || p_old): mean, median, p95, p99, max
student-minus-old expected kernel mass split by advantage sign
Beta mean absolute change by coordinate
log-concentration change by coordinate: median, p05, p95, min, max
entropy by coordinate: median, p05, p95
actor and critic shared-trunk norms and cosine
capture time, steady-state SPS, total SPS
actor and critic examples and optimizer steps
pre_run_gates.critic_ev_policy: critic explained variance is a measured confound and outcome; schedule parity does not guarantee recovery
pre_run_gates.fail_action: restore parity or relabel the experiment; no MLQ run

frozen_evaluation_protocol.first_run_claim_limit: seed 1 is feasibility and one descriptive learning curve only
frozen_evaluation_protocol.superiority_requirement: matched additional seeds, identical evaluation, and uncertainty

broken optimizer, CUDA graph, checkpoint, logging, or score path
